title: Resubmission Result
description: The answer to an Order Event Resubmission (UC-008 step 6, A1 to A3). Trailhead Gear owns it. It allows no other field, so that no Customer name, email address or Shipping Address can get into it (UC-008 BR-004).

eventId.description: Event id of the resubmitted Order Event.

result.description: `taken-in`: received as a Peakmart Order (UC-008 step 6); `already-received`: skipped as a Duplicate (A3); `still-unreadable`: kept set aside (A2); `not-found`: no such Set-Aside Order Event is kept (A1).

orderNumber.description: Order Number of the Peakmart Order; only for `taken-in` and `already-received`.

reason.description: What cannot be read, readable by a person; only for `still-unreadable`. Names no personal data.
